correctionNotes: Use the Super* Review clone-IEC711 standard-fit L/R average (REW, 2026-05-21) as the primary measured baseline: squig.link files Symphonium Zenith L/R.

Relative to Crinacle IEF Preference 2025 (IEC711: JM-1 delta + 105 Hz +8 dB low shelf Q 0.71 + 2500 Hz -4 dB high shelf Q 0.4), trim the extra sub-bass, clean ~160 Hz and ~1.7 kHz, restore ~3 kHz presence, and relax ~7 kHz.

Do not chase the 10 kHz dip or other narrow peaks above 7 kHz: Super* Review shallow/deep/S2 plus Elise Audio and Twister6/Animagus 711 traces show strong insertion-depth and coupler sensitivity there.
signature: Sub-bass-forward 4BA flagship IEM (Symphonium x Elise Audio) with a slightly recessed 3 kHz presence versus IEF Preference 2025, extra 6–7 kHz energy, and a fit-sensitive 10 kHz dip on 711.
source: Measured Super* Review squig.link clone IEC711 standard-fit L/R average, 2026-05-21: https://squig.link/ (Symphonium Audio x Elise Audio Zenith). Cross-check: Super* Review shallow/deep/S2, Elise Audio squig https://eliseaudio.squig.link/ (Symphonium x Elise Zenith), Twister6 Animagus IEC711 https://animagus.squig.link/ and review https://twister6.com/2026/06/24/symphonium-audio-x-elise-audio-zenith/ .
